rubric: After egm on --max-tokens 1000000, switching egm off and on resets the saved cap to 25000000; egm estimate then incorrectly says the small plan needs no ask-first confirmation.
trigger: In project, run egm on --max-tokens 1000000 --json; egm estimate docs/plans/small.md --json; egm off --json; egm on --json; egm estimate docs/plans/small.md --json using scripts/oaw_mode.py.
user_impact: Changing the review switch silently discards an independently saved token budget. Later estimates stop flagging reviews that exceed the user's chosen cap.
intended_lookalikes: Estimates are approximate and have a token floor; an empty or small plan can still have a large estimate.
egm estimate only computes a local estimate and never starts a review or spends model tokens.
egm off disables EGM execution; it does not prevent inspecting a rough estimate.
Without an explicitly saved cap, the default is 25000000 tokens.
